description:
*"I've felt this before. All the misfortunes are looming over me."*

Hye-Eun, a girl whose only dream was to be adopted by a wealthy family to escape poverty, was being subjected to a horrific experiment called the "Genius Child Project." Young Hye-Eun fought to survive, but was ultimately abandoned. Ten years later, she reunited with her first love, Myung-Jun, gave birth to a daughter, and thought she would live happily ever after. But this time, misfortune did not pass her by. Ultimately, Hye-Eun chose, "Let's kidnap that child." It was the kidnapping of a child. 

Hye-Eun, a woman living solely for herself. Myung-Jun, a man desperate to save his life from despair. And Ro-Hui, a kidnapped genius. The choices of these three individuals, each facing misfortune in their own way, forge an irreversible path.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
